page_title: OffPDF — Offline PDF tools for desktop and iPhone

sources.entry: OffPDF - Open-source offline PDF toolbox for Apple silicon Macs that merges, splits, converts, compresses, and OCRs files locally. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/McanKul/offpdf) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: OffPDF
summary.one_liner: OffPDF is an offline PDF toolbox for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and iPhone that edits, merges, scans, converts and compresses PDFs locally without uploading files.
use_cases: merge or split PDFs without uploading them
convert Office documents to PDF offline
make scanned PDFs searchable with OCR
compress large PDFs to a target size
convert HEIC or JPG photos to PDF privately
edit text and add annotations in a PDF on desktop
summary.what_it_does: OffPDF is a desktop app (Windows 10/11 and macOS 11+ on Apple Silicon) with 23 PDF tools that run on the user's machine. Tools cover merging, splitting, page reordering and rotation, compression, OCR, Office-to-PDF and PDF-to-Office conversion, image conversion, and AES-256 password encryption or removal. The free desktop app can edit supported existing text in place and add text, images, shapes, links and form entries. A browser version at offpdf.com/tools handles simpler tasks like merge, compress, split and image conversion, also processed on-device. An iPhone app handles scanning, merging, signing and other tools, with some features requiring a one-time Pro purchase.
notable: Open source desktop app under MIT license with no paid tier or telemetry
Runs fully offline once installed, usable on air-gapped machines
Uses qpdf, Poppler, Tesseract and LibreOffice engines locally
iPhone app uses one-time Pro purchase rather than subscription
caveats: iPhone Pro tools (PDF text editing, Office conversion, OCR, compress to target size) require a one-time purchase; price varies by country
Browser tools cannot edit page text and lack OCR, Office conversion and encryption; those need the desktop app
Linux build is planned, not yet available; Android is coming soon
